name: s84-stop-gate-no-python-keeps-every-failure
setup_commands: mkdir -p minbin && for t in bash sh git dirname basename tr date mkdir tail head sed grep cat env rm mv cp perl sleep cksum; do p=$(command -v "$t") && ln -sf "$p" "minbin/$t"; done; true
notes: No python3 and no jq. Only the last run was kept — a.sh failed, b.sh passed, and stop allowed with a.sh still broken. The gate now keeps a plain per-file log (quality-gate-files.tsv) that stop-gate reads with bash alone: latest line per file wins.
